pl-l3d32c4-d1e115.summary: Asks whether one person is loved more by God at one time than another, and distinguishes: granted if referred to the effect of love, denied if referred to its essence.
claims: The question is granted regarding effect and denied regarding essence.

pl-l3d32c4.summary: Asks whether one person is loved more by God at one time than at another, and answers by distinguishing the sense: it can be granted if it refers to the effect of love, but must be denied if it refers to love's essence.
claims: One may be loved more by God at one time than another according to the effect, not the essence, of love.
